items.name: Reduce Windows suggestions
items.description: Preview only: reduce selected tips, recommendations, and promotional suggestions in Windows.
items.effect: Windows tips and promotional suggestions would be reduced.

items.name: Show file extensions
items.description: Show endings such as .txt, .jpg, and .exe in File Explorer.
items.effect: File Explorer would show extensions for known file types.

items.name: Show hidden files
items.description: Display hidden files and folders; protected operating system files stay hidden.
items.effect: Hidden files and folders would appear in File Explorer.

items.name: Use the Balanced power plan
items.description: Preview only: an example laptop power choice; no real power handler is implemented yet.
items.effect: The Balanced power plan would be selected on supported laptops.

items.name: Remove Microsoft Solitaire Collection
items.description: Preview only: example inbox-app cleanup for the current user, if the app is installed.
items.effect: Microsoft Solitaire Collection would be removed for the current user if present.
